name:
Layton's Mystery Journey™:
Update
description:
An update for Layton's Mystery Journey™ is now available from Nintendo eShop.
All customers who own a copy of Layton's Mystery Journey™ should download the update. This will update the software to Version 1.2 with the following amendments:

- Various bug fixes.

• Once the update has been downloaded, it will be installed automatically.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused, and recommend downloading this update to ensure a smooth game experience.
